verdict.rationale: Loops documents lifecycle workflows that are started by events and can be edited as graphs from code. Nothing in the evidence shows per-contact visibility into a person's current position in a workflow, or a way to remove or re-enter an individual contact mid-flow. Starting workflows via events and editing nodes are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
